notes: The key fix: h-suppression (both single-word and multi-word tail) happens exactly when the relevant word is all-lowercase, ends in o/y, was changed by collapse, **and starts with 'h'** — this explains why hello/hallo/hullo suppress but jello/yellow/fellow/follow keep the h, and why `dog hello`→`dog hel` has no h despite the filtered tail ending in a consonant.
